title.zh: 韩国金融委员会：虚拟资产交易平台大股东持股限制的规定，并非针对特定人士或企业
title.en: 韩国金融委员会：虚拟资产交易平台大股东持股限制的规定，并非针对特定人士或企业

current_state.zh: South Korea's FSC Chairman said the Digital Asset Basic Act's limits on major shareholder stakes in virtual asset exchanges target public responsibility rather than specific people or companies, and that exchanges will move from three-year registration renewals to a licensing regime.
current_state.en: South Korea's FSC Chairman said the Digital Asset Basic Act's limits on major shareholder stakes in virtual asset exchanges target public responsibility rather than specific people or companies, and that exchanges will move from three-year registration renewals to a licensing regime.
